mapper.select: SELECT AUTH_ID AS AUTHID ,NAME , AUTH_DC AS AUTHDC , CREATE_DT AS CREATEDT FROM KX_AUTHINFO ORDER BY CREATE_DT DESC
SELECT AUTH_ID AS AUTHID ,NAME , AUTH_DC AS AUTHDC , CREATE_DT AS CREATEDT FROM KX_AUTHINFO WHERE AUTH_ID = #{authId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO KX_AUTHINFO (AUTH_ID, NAME, AUTH_DC, CREATE_DT) VALUES (#{authId}, #{name}, #{authDc}, sysdate)
mapper.select: SELECT AUTH.AUTH_ID AS AUTHID FROM KX_AUTHINFO AUTH , KX_USERAUTH USERAUTH WHERE AUTH.AUTH_ID = USERAUTH.AUTH_ID AND USERAUTH.USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT AUTH.AUTH_ID AS AUTHID FROM KX_AUTHINFO AUTH , KX_MENUINFO MENU WHERE AUTH.AUTH_ID = MENU.AUTH_ID AND NVL(MENU.USE_FLAG, 'Y') != 'N' AND MENU.MENU_ID = #{menuId}
SELECT AUTH_ID AS AUTHID FROM KX_AUTHINFO ORDER BY CREATE_DT DESC
